work: Created the separately ticketed Ngong Ping 360 Cable Car as a fixed scenic transport attraction distinct from the adjacent village experiences. Integrated eight editorial descriptions, the official Tung Chung terminal position, three exact inspected licensed photos, nine current round-trip fares, ordinary weekly hours, three sourced access conditions, eight public locale routes and the Facebook post.
qualification: The operator markets both its permanent 5.7 km cable car between Tung Chung and Ngong Ping and the adjacent village. The cable car has a distinct ticket, terminals, route and visitor experience; a StandaloneAttraction page is appropriate.
sourceLimitations: Ordinary weekly opening hours are published by the operator; public holidays, festive dates and suspension announcements require a current-day check and are not encoded as ordinary weekdays.
The official 20th anniversary page corroborates opening in 2006 but does not establish the exact opening day.
The installed ropeway manufacturer and precise equipment model were not independently established.
